drawing_observation.observation: exact .009 sheet-3 detail proves D96.9 Q2 and D96.11 CLK2 leave on distinct conductors; D96.11 crosses D28.10-to-D96.10 without a junction dot. The full overview traces Q2 to D101 A0-A3 and CLK2 to D94.2.

component_observation.observation: registered component-side package fit fixes both pad identities; visible local top-side copper is partly hidden by D96 and adjacent parts and does not expose a unique remote destination

solder_observation.observation: registered reflected package fit fixes both solder pads; neither pad has a B.Cu departure, so any remote continuation is on F.Cu or changes layer at a separately obscured handoff

non_promotion_basis: both D96.9-to-D101 and D96.11-to-D94.2 are source-closed by the full overview, but registered board views exclude direct B.Cu chases and leave F.Cu paths obscured; direct continuity is required.

overview_observation.observation: D96.9 Q2 turns down and left to the shared D101 A0-A3 input conductor. D96.11 CLK2 turns upward to the conductor drawn from D94.2. The D96.11 line crosses D28.10-to-D96.10 without a junction dot.
